hint.args: One argument per line.  substitution is supported.
hint.command: Absolute path or a path relative to your cognia install.  substitution is supported.
hint.env: One KEY=VALUE per line, merged onto the spawned process environment.
hint.extensions: Comma-separated, with or without the leading dot. Used by the agent runtime to match files.
hint.languages: Comma-separated list of Monaco language ids.
hint.rootMarkers: Comma-separated marker files — the agent starts the server at the nearest directory containing one (e.g. Cargo.toml).
hint.settings: Server-specific configuration served for workspace/configuration pulls.
